## Cloning

Now, the submodule has been added to your repository. When other people clone your repository, they can initialize and update the submodule using:

```bash
git submodule init
git submodule update
```

Or, they can clone the repository with submodules in one step using:

```bash
git clone --recurse-submodules <main-repository-url>
```
